about: The search test for find_tools (TOOL_ACCESS_PLAN §7.1), written on 2026-11-27 in stage 0, before any tool card existed. Each query is what a user or a model would type to find a Kaaga tool, written from the job and not from the tool's text: short ones and whole sentences, mostly in the user's voice, some in the model's ("tool to mark a review done"), with mixed words (delete, remove, trash, get rid of; course or subject; lesson, doc or note; review or revision). tools: every tool that is a right answer (any one of them counts). The names are the final ones: get_quiz_results, get_standing and suggest_to_user (renamed), the pocket, subject and file tools (new); never more_tools, find_tools, use_read_tool or use_tool. Every tool has at least two queries, the ones models confuse (saving something, where they stand, changing a doc, a review) three or four, and a tool's queries sit together. held: true on every third entry (the 3rd, 6th, 9th...): never read while tuning keywords. playbooks: queries that must answer a playbook's steps, three a playbook, every third held. set_folder can't be reached on the web door: a run on that door leaves out the query that names only set_folder.
